members.name: David Theodore
members.role: Executive director and board member, proposer and lead (per the proposal); author of the Argus article on ethsecurity.org

organization.name: Eth Security
organization.summary: Describes itself on ethsecurity.org as an independent nonprofit exploit research organization. The proposal says the legal entity is Eth Security Inc, a Delaware nonprofit being formed. The site publishes one article, 'Argus', about its AI-assisted bug-hunting system.

claims.claim: EthSec's public site is ethsecurity.org and describes Argus.
claims.method: Both pages load. The Argus article, by David Theodore, dated 2026-11-16, describes a continuous AI bug-hunting engine. The site's contents are the applicant's own statements.

claims.claim: Argus is already in use internally for AI-driven security review.
claims.method: The article states the system runs as a live system and has surfaced high and critical severity issues. No finding is named or linked, so the claim cannot be checked.

claims.claim: Eth Security Inc is a Delaware nonprofit being formed.
claims.method: The site footer says 'Independent Nonprofit Public-Benefit Exploit Research'. No registry record was checked.

claims.claim: David Theodore was a founding member of the Ethereum Foundation Protocol Security Team and a founding board member of SEAL.
claims.method: No public page confirming these roles was fetched.
